pages.text: Realm stewards possess sterner words under $(thing)/mystcraft$(). The chief ones are $(li)/mystcraft time set ...$(li)/mystcraft weather ...$(li)/mystcraft instability toggle$(li)/mystcraft age_effect toggle$(li)/mystcraft sacrifice <age>$().

Most such words act upon the Age beneath your boots, unless another Age is named outright. Use them for stewardship, rescue, testing, or careful curation. Do not mistake them for ordinary traveler's tools.
